purpose: AC-1 byte-identity oracle: pre-E3 Krea 2 turbo render on the LIVE engine (binary built 2026-08-18 from fix/face-anchor-icref-broadcast; Krea2 sources identical to origin/main at that date)

request.prompt: a woman sitting on the edge of a bed in a bedroom, warm lamplight
request.quantization: q8 (server default — WarmServer loads Krea 2 with quantizeTransformer: 8)

image_sha256_note: SHA-256 of the PNG's IHDR chunk data followed by every IDAT chunk's data: the raster geometry and the pixels, and nothing else. This — not the whole-file `sha256` above — is what AC-1 compares, because the whole-file hash is NOT reproducible across processes: QwenImageIO.ImageMetadata.generation serialises an unordered Swift Dictionary, so the eXIf/iTXt chunks come out with a different key order in every process. Verified 2026-08-22 on this exact request: the pre-refactor render and the post-refactor render differ in 344 bytes, ALL of them inside file offsets 233..1474 (the eXIf and iTXt chunks), and are byte-identical from the first IDAT chunk to EOF. Both digests above were read off the same pre-refactor file.
